en.title: Research desk stops or seems inactive
en.advice: Research consumes camp power over time. Watch the Hub panel during research; check supply rather than assuming starting research is a one-off power cost.
en.limits: The developer describes Utility Wasp, fuel generator and researched solar panels as supply options. Research UX improvements are planned, not confirmed released; no fixed power rate or default key is established.

zh.title: 研究台停止或看起来没反应
zh.advice: 研究会随时间消耗营地电力。研究时查看 Hub 面板并检查供应，不要把启动研究当作一次性耗电。
zh.limits: 开发者列举 Utility Wasp、燃料发电机及研究后太阳能板等供电方式；研究 UX 改进仍是计划，未确认发布，本文没有固定功率或默认按键。

evidence.en: devl0f confirms ongoing power use and recommends watching the Hub panel.
evidence.zh: devl0f 确认研究持续耗电，并建议观察 Hub 面板。

en.title: Weather data: settlement or military base?
en.advice: The developer places weather data in the largest settlement on the same island, inside a larger upper building. The military base with the Striker is a different target.
en.limits: Detailed wiring/battery directions are separate player guidance, not developer-confirmed steps. No coordinates or guaranteed route are supplied.

zh.title: 天气数据：聚落还是军事基地？
zh.advice: 开发者说明天气数据位于同一岛上最大的聚落、上部的一座较大建筑里；有 Striker 的军事基地是另一个目标。
zh.limits: 具体接线和电池路线属于独立玩家建议，不是开发者确认步骤；本文不提供坐标或保证通关的路线。

evidence.en: Fredrik distinguishes the two targets.
evidence.zh: Fredrik 区分了两个不同目标。

evidence.en: Other replies discuss wiring and batteries; their full route is not independently verified here.
evidence.zh: 其他回帖讨论接线和电池，完整路线尚未在本站独立核实。

en.title: Camp Hub trunk while docked: EA 1.0-5 history
en.advice: Historical EA 1.0-5 tracking: docked Camp Hub trunk access was intended, but an interaction bug was being tracked.
en.limits: The possible large-pad workaround and planned hotfix describe the earlier reply. See the separate EA 1.0-6 VENU-14674 entry for the later official fix; no restoration of lost items is promised.

zh.title: 停靠箱子：EA 1.0-5 历史状态
zh.advice: EA 1.0-5 历史追踪：停靠时应能访问 Camp Hub 箱子，但当时正追踪交互 Bug。
zh.limits: 大停机坪临时办法和热修计划属于早期回帖；后续官方修复见独立 EA 1.0-6 VENU-14674 条目，不承诺恢复丢失物品。

evidence.en: devl0f confirms intended access and tracked interaction trouble; possible large-pad workaround only.
evidence.zh: devl0f 确认应可访问且正追踪交互问题；大停机坪只是可能绕行。

en.title: Camp chests do not appear on extreme terrain
en.advice: Distinguish a placement failure after redeploying. Compare with flatter terrain and inspect the Hub before rebuilding.
en.limits: Developer explanation and a player recovery observation are separate. Neither guarantees that all missing chests or contents will return.

zh.limits: 开发者的地形解释和玩家找回观察是不同证据；都不保证所有箱子或内容物恢复。

evidence.en: Buildables can fail placement on extreme terrain; warning UX was missing.
evidence.zh: 极端地形可能导致摆放失败，且缺少警告提示。

evidence.en: A player found chests in the Hub and placed them again.
